fact: The Ministry of Education's partnership compact of April 2023 states that EMIS still largely collects data on paper, that it should be fully digitised with students and teachers uniquely identified by their IDs and integrated with the Ministry's SMIS, TMIS and GIS, and that moving EMIS to a fully digitised system is a priority intervention in the concept note for the EETP and the plans for the GPE System Transformation Grant.
title: Ethiopia and GPE Partnership Compact Focused on: Improving Learning Outcomes
publisher: Ministry of Education, Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia
